name: Come Back Lucy
summary: Young Lucy is bereaved and sent to live with her cousins. She makes a friend in Alice. But Alice has been dead for over a hundred years and wishes to drag Lucy back in time, to play with her for eternity.

name: Quanto Mais Vida, Melhor!
summary: After dying in a plane crash, Paula, Neném, Flávia and Guilherme receive a second chance at Death under one condition: they must fix their lives and, after a year, only one of them will die permanently.

name: Mis 3 hermanas
summary: It is the story of a true love and how conflicts arise from this love that are too difficult to be faced by a family.

name: Enamorada
summary: Young Ivana Robles falls in love with Raimundo Alvarade at first sight, not even knowing what this love will bring her. With all her might, she tries to force Raimundo to reciprocate her feelings, and in the end she gets her way. This is where the tale ends. Raimundo's fiancee, Patti, is not going to give her fiancé to her rival and declares that she is pregnant. Raymundo has to get married. In addition, Ivana is accused of murder. Will the lovers be able to overcome all the trials and keep their feelings?..

name: Ночной режим
summary: Fashion photographer Roman Belov was sentenced to life in prison for the murder of four people. Roman is absolutely sure of his innocence, but cannot remember what really happened on the fateful night. In prison, a mysterious man who calls himself Master appears in his dreams and offers to help him find the real killer. But how to investigate if you are locked in a stone bag? And what price will have to be paid for the services of a person who can penetrate dreams?

name: Q Transformers: Kaette Kita Convoy no Nazo

previousepisode.name: The Road to Q-Transformers: The Movie

name: Sue Perkins: Perfectly Legal
summary: Sue Perkins confronts middle age head-on by experiencing various Latin American countries in adventurous, shockingly legal and sometimes dangerous ways.

name: The Walk-In
summary: Based on real events, The Walk-In follows an activist and his advocacy group as they confront an extremist organisation.

name: The Real Hunt for Red October
summary: A look at the events that inspired Tom Clancy's The Hunt for Red October. For the first time, the extraordinary events behind this occurrence can be revealed.

name: Scanners
summary: Pursued by relentless agents with unimaginable powers, two women living on the fringes of modern society must learn to work together to topple a vast conspiracy determined to bring them to heel.

name: Bad Hair Day
summary: Patients with extreme hair-related medical issues seek out Dr. Angie Phipps, Dr. Meena Singh and Dr. Isha Lopez for life-changing procedures and treatments.

name: The Ring & The Crown
summary: The Ring & The Crown is set in an Arthurian world in which magic exists. It centers on Princess Marie-Victoria, the heir to the mightiest empire in the world, who is being forced into a political marriage, and her dear friend Aelwyn Myrddyn, the bastard daughter of Merlin, who is being forced into service of the crown. The Annual London Season is just beginning, and as noble families from across the globe are gathering to flaunt their wealth and magic at lavish parties, behind the scenes, Marie-Victoria, Aelwyn, and others are making moves to secure political power, true love, and their futures.

name: Park Ha Kyung Travel Diary
summary: Set in the 1990's, Park Ha Kyung teaches Korean literature at a high school. To escape her ordinary days, Park Ha Kyung decides to take one day trips on Saturdays. During her one day trip, she walks around, eats different foods, and meets various people. She realizes she receives comfort and empathy through her travels.

name: Payback: Money and Power
summary: A thrilling revenge drama about the good fighting without hesitation with everything to fight against a 'cartel' that has conspired with the law.

name: The Truth About My Murder
summary:
The engrossing original series The Truth About My Murder comes to CBS Reality this September.

When a murder is committed, it's always a race against time to find the truth - to separate fact from fiction, catch the killer, and to make sure that justice is served. But what happens when the truth vanishes with the victim?

Forensic pathologist Dr Richard Shepherd has performed nearly 23,000 autopsies, inclusive of some of the most high-profile cases of recent times. He's learnt that the dead don't hide the truth and they never lie. Through Dr Richard Shepherd, you'll be hearing directly from the victims. From a state-of-the-art laboratory, with ground-breaking technology that uses digitally scanned sample bodies, he'll be investigating a series of intriguing murders where from the victims' bodies, he'll be revealing the truth behind those perplexing crimes.

name: Modern Love Tokyo
summary: The Amazon Original series "Modern Love," based on a column that appeared in The New York Times, has been distributed since 2019. Now "Modern Love" reboots with a new look in Tokyo as "Modern Love Tokyo." The seven-episode anthology features a cast of leading actors and depicts various forms of "love," such as love almost forgotten, love between sons and mothers, and love that transcends borders.

name: I Ate Well Today
summary: A healing travel drama depicting the process of sharing food in the natural landscapes of Daegu, Andong, Yeonju, and Mungyeong.

name: Saving the Manor
summary: HGTV will transport viewers to the ultimate fairytale location in its newest renovation series, Saving the Manor. During the series, cameras will follow couple Dean Poulton and Borja de Maqua as they single-handedly renovate a magnificent, yet dilapidated, ten-building, 65-room historic English estate that dates back more than 500 years. Sitting on land once owned by King Henry VII, the sprawling retreat is now in ruins, but Dean and Borja will pour their life savings and determination into fully restoring the property with a nod to authentic preservation. To turn the buildings and grounds into a successful income stream with vacation rentals and special event space—as well as create their own private home—Dean, an architect, and Borja, a former real estate agent, will complete every part of the colossal renovation themselves, resulting in a final epic reveal.

name: Spot the Dog
summary: Jordan and Wyatt go on the hunt for Neena, a miniature longhair dachshund with a nose for peanut butter.

name: Dance & Sing with True
summary: True and her friends make music and invite you to dance and sing along. So have fun and shake a leg to their fun tunes.

name: Pandora: Beneath the Paradise
summary: In order to protect her beloved family, Hong Tae Ra must become the First Lady of Korea. Hong Tae Ra has a perfect life with her beloved husband Pyo Jae Hyun and their loverly daughter, except for one thing. Hong Tae Ra has no recollection of her past. One day, she regains her memory and faces her harrowing past. Her perfect life is now broken and she finds herself in an uncontrollable situation. Hong Tae Ra struggles to take revenge on those responsible for her past. Pyo Jae Hyun is married to Hong Tae Ra. He is an extremely smart developer, who developed new technology in the neural smart patch field. He runs his company with gentle leadership skills and a sensible personality. He is admired by those around him. People in the political world begin to talk about him as the next presidential candidate.

name: Chasing the Undercurrent
summary: Chang Zheng, the vice captain of the criminal police brigade, is investigating a shooting case in a suburban villa and locks up the suspect Zhao Peng Xiang. The second child of the Zhao family, an inspector who didn't want to be involved in the death of Zhao Pengcheng, then becomes a wanted criminal. With the help of a secret investigation team dispatched by the Ministry of Public Security to investigate the truth, Chang Zheng not only faces confrontation with his relatives and loved ones, but also discovers his real identity. In the end, he discards his affection and chooses justice, and cooperates with the secret investigation team of the Ministry of Public Security to arrest the criminal.

name: Akiba Maid War
summary: Arriving in the great district of Akihabara, Nagomi Wahira discovers with wonder the profession of Maid, and dreams of becoming one in turn. More ready than ever to invest 100% in this discipline, she quickly discovers the real difficulty and the fierce competition that reigns in the industry. Alongside Ranko Mannen, her new colleague and rival, the young woman throws herself headlong into this activity, with a lot of curiosity and motivation!

name: Catch Me Baby
summary: Phat is the ultimate 'Relationship Juggler' under the guise of an executive assistant for Sia Wut who has a total of five girlfriends. Phat's main job is to juggler each of the girlfriends and make sure that none of them find out about the other. Nothing is as easy as it seems, especially with the mysterious arrival of Cher; the new female executive assistant who later reveals herself to be an 'Infidelity Detective.' As Phat's relationship juggling missions becomes more challenging, he employs the help of Pinky; his adopted sister with a performance edge; Jim (a fellow executive assistant) and Captain; who happens to be Foie (Cher's cousin)'s rival. It's a cat and mouse game between Phat and Cher as their missions often intersect—making it hard to keep their feelings for one another strictly professional. The mission must go on—but will Phat be able to stop himself from developing feelings for the enemy?

name: Supreme Galaxy
summary: The Star Sect was once the most dazzling clan of the Blue Earth Star, the Star Clan, accidentally obtained the "Star Map", which attracted the prying eyes of the Lord of the Universe , who, in order to obtain the Star Map, induced the senior members of the Star Clan to go to the Sacred Star Domain and imprisoned them in the "Sacred Star Domain". Only one guardian elder Zhuge Haohan and young master Chu Xinghe and a few young disciples remained in the Star Sect. They were suppressed by other sects due to lack of strength, and were taken away by the Ying Clan . In order to regain its glory, the young master Chu Xinghe led his disciples to break through twelve star realms and defeat the 12 Star Practitioners under the Lord of the Universe . In the end, he saved his father and all the people of the Star Sect.

name: The Unforgettable
summary: Series following the lives of some of the UK's best loved actors.

name: The Little Lies We All Tell
Эльбрус. Точка невозврата
summary: On September 23, 2021, a group of hikers on Mount Elbrus was forced to fight for survival amidst ferocious weather. This honest documentary drama about the tragedy that shook the nation presents events from the participants' own perspectives as they recount their desperate struggle to stay alive. A sudden turn for the worse in the weather, a blizzard, zero visibility, indifferent mountains, and an icy hell—there is nothing romantic about the fight for survival. Yet, even in such conditions, there was room for the heroism of ordinary people, for self-sacrifice, and for humanity. It is a cautionary series about the indifference of the elements and a poignant story about the love of life.

name: Slumberkins
summary: Based on the leading children's emotional learning brand Slumberkins, the series brings to life some of the beloved characters from the Slumberkins books as they explore new stories of friendship, confidence and connection to model healthy relationships.

previousepisode.name: The Grass Is Greener at Bigfoot's

name: Phantom Pups
summary: A young boy and his family move into a haunted home, where he meets three adorable ghost pups and tries to help them turn back into real dogs.

name: Leopard Skin
summary: Fleeing a botched diamond heist, a criminal gang seeks shelter in the remote paradise of Playa Perdida, Mexico in the beachside estate of two women, Alba and Batty. Dark and humorous complications arise when they are joined by two dinner guests (TV producer Max and his flighty girlfriend Maru) and Alba's former housekeeper as they all are soon taken hostage. Murderous secrets, coldhearted betrayals, and shocking desires bubble to the surface as everyone awaits their fate.

previousepisode.name: The Myth of the Guilty Murderess

name: Gang Zielonej Rękawiczki
summary: When their latest heist goes wrong, three older female burglars evade officials by hiding out in a nursing home — where they uncover a sinister secret.

name: Ghost Files
summary: Ryan Bergara and Shane Madej return to ghost hunting to attempt to recreate the internet's best paranormal evidence in the world's most haunted locations in a quest to prove the paranormal.

previousepisode.name: Sleeping At Oregon's Most Haunted Lighthouse

name: Teletubbies
summary: Join colorful friends Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po on wonder-filled adventures as they learn and grow in this 21st century refresh of the beloved preschool series, now narrated by Emmy-nominee Tituss Burgess (Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt). Each episode includes new, original "Tummy Tales" songs that will have the entire family dancing along!

name: Interrupting Chicken
summary: A young little chicken named Piper has a habit of interrupting storytime! Every time Piper hears a story, she can't help but jump in, ask questions and let her imagination run wild as she tries to fill in details, guess what happens next or insert herself in the middle of the action to help save the day.

name: SELF
summary:
Their relationship has been connected by the reflection in the mirror. 

Tang finds out that his reflection in the mirror has disappeared, replaced by a terrifying stranger attempting to commit something very severe.  Tang has to find a way to bring back his reflection and stop the stranger in the mirror before it's too late. The reflection... the lost self... and trust...

name: Oddballs
summary: Follow James, a bubble-shaped boy, whose observations on life fuel his comedic rants at everyday annoyances and elevates them to laughably absurd heights. Along with his best friends Max (a talking crocodile) and Echo (a girl who claims to be from the future), James' ridiculous schemes to question norms often result in disaster.

name: First Love
summary: Young, free and madly in love. As teenagers, the world was their oyster — but as adults, their lives seem dimmer, like a very important piece is missing.

name: Hanawake no Yon Shimai
summary: Daigo Hanawa is a father who is popular with the ladies. He's married to Sachiko Hanawa, a girlish mom who loves her husband unconditionally. They have four daughters and, unlike their father, all have zero luck with the opposite sex. Eldest daughter Fujiko is a single career woman who works at a fashion magazine and is highly competitive. Second daughter Takemi is the black sheep of the family. She has been divorced two times and has three children. Third daughter Sakurako works at a wig factory and is on the lookout for a marriage minded man. She's easily swayed by others. Youngest daughter Ume is a 2nd year theater student at an art college. She is a late bloomer and has had no experience with falling in love.

name: Boizu On Za Ran
summary: A twenty-something salaryman working for a toy company has never had any success with the ladies. He is interested so instead he takes solace in adult videos and the such. He falls for a co-worker, but assumes he will never headway with a cute girl and it may be true until a competitor whispers in his ears.

name: Hi wa Mata Noboru
summary: Detective Kazuyuki Tono becomes an instructor at the police academy. He comes across many new recruits, including one particularly talented cadet named Eiji Miyata.

previousepisode.name: 卒業〜さらば愛しき教官

name: Ralph & Katie
summary: Spin-off from The A Word, following the first year of Ralph and Katie's marriage

name: Saikou no Jinsei no Owarikata: Ending Planner
summary: Ihara Masato takes over his family funeral parlor business which he has always hated. Masato has to face the dead bodies which have died of various causes, and the harsh reality of the world, together with a rookie detective Sakamaki Yuki.

name: The Legend
summary: A law school graduate, Ramadan, from a poor suburb in Cairo is trying to join the judiciary, but the bad reputation of his brother, an arms dealer, prevents him from reaching his dream.

name: Das Haus der Träume
summary: Berlin in the 1920's. A dazzling place, but times are not only golden, they are marked by poverty and crime. Vicky arrives in the city, led by promises of a better life, she's looking for a job. But as soon as she gets there, her hopes and dreams are met with a cold awakening. With no place to stay and nothing to her name, she hires on to work as a saleswoman at a newly-established, glamorous department store. But the founders are also fighting for survival, just like Vicky. Times are tough, and it's about to get tougher.

name: Тяжёлый пар
summary: The host tests the erudition of the star guests in extreme conditions. For each wrong answer, the temperature in the studio rises by five degrees.

name: Lesson of the Evil: Prologue
summary: Prequel to the Lesson of the Evil movie that gives us a look into Seiji Hasumi's history.

name: Höllgrund
summary: A series of mysterious deaths haunts a tranquil village in the Black Forest. The village police officer Tanja is sure that there is a dark secret behind the incidents. Against the resistance of the other villagers and against the orders of her superior, Tanja begins to investigate on her own. Little does she know that the new country doctor Fabian is involved in the mysterious series of murders...

name: García!
summary: In a present-day Spain, divided and on the brink of political chaos, inquisitive millennial investigative reporter Antonia stumbles on a decades-old conspiracy: the existence of a cryogenically frozen super-agent, García, created in a laboratory in the 1950s by General Franco's fascist secret services. After sixty years in deep sleep, this perfect soldier with incredible physical strength, programmed to obey orders without question, is woken by Antonia. García finds himself disoriented and confused in a Spain that has changed beyond recognition. The old-world collides with the new as García and Antonia must learn to work together as they are drawn deeper and deeper into a political conspiracy that threatens to overthrow democracy and plunge Spain back into brutal dictatorship.

name: Когда растаял снег
summary: 1939 Major of State Security Shuvalov invites Anna, a young capable student of the Faculty of Philology, to become an employee of a special department. Anna, who sees herself as a philologist, but not a scout, categorically refuses, but after she is expelled from the university on a false denunciation, she nevertheless accepts Shuvalov's offer. Performing one of the tasks, Anna accidentally meets the German submariner Walter von Rieden. Young people are imbued with each other with a mutual feeling that will eventually turn their whole life upside down

name: NieR:Automata Ver1.1a
summary: Animated adaptation of NieR: Automata (2017), where a long-running war on post-apocalyptic Earth between androids and machines soon unveils the truth of the world.

name: Соколова подозревает всех
summary: The meticulousness and professionalism of investigator Ulyana Sokolova was not liked by everyone in the capital, and there were people who helped her move to the small, deeply provincial city of Andreevsk. After moving to a new place, the heroine learns that the circumstances of her predecessor's death are very murky, so she decides to look into this story, unaware of the interests of which forces she will affect. It turns out that even in a provincial town there are their own "godfathers", who quickly get caught up in the turbulent activity of the new detective. In addition, the personality of Alexander Admiralov's partner, a former classmate and former lover, adds difficulties to Ulyana. Old feelings are returning with the same force, so Sokolova has pain points, which some people are eager to put pressure on.

name: O Menino Maluquinho
summary: Nutty Boy is an out-of-the-box kid with big ideas who loves involving everyone in his adventures — even though they don't usually go as planned!

name: Sunday with Michael Portillo
summary: Join Michael Portillo and guests for a relaxed look at the world of politics, culture and the arts.

name: Traitor
summary: After a flight from Tel Aviv to Bangkok vanishes in mid-air, with no signs of an explosion, crash or hijacking, the entire world is left mesmerized. Yonatan Georgy is a recently blind intelligence officer returning to work, tasked with investigating the plane's disappearance - with his wife and children on board. At the same time, families of the passengers start realizing they didn't know their loved ones as well as they thought.

name: Sommarkollo
summary: A summer filled with drama, love, betrayal, friendship and experiences Sommarollo is a TV and Web drama series for 8-13 year olds. Five 13-year-olds spend a week of their summer in a summer camp. The summer is filled with drama, love, betrayal, friendship and experiences. Before the camp and TV sections we get to know the young people through social media; Each character puts out its own youtube video in a couple of weeks, and during the videos and the series, one can also follow the characters of Instagram. The series should reflect a summer feeling of warmth, sunsets, dull summer mornings and speed, but we are not afraid to enter into feelings such as sorrow or loneliness; We all do stupid or bad things sometimes and everybody has an inner strength. Nobody is perfect.

name: Florentine
summary: A brilliant series about the lives of a young group of people, who are best friends since their childhood in Jerusalem. They all moved together to live in the southern tel-avivian neighborhood 'florentine'. The series shows the confusion of a young person in a country that is in constant war. The way they deal with lose, they way they deny the truth especially to themselves, and the self destructive tendencies they have, which eventually affect other people in the group.

name: Cool Doji Danshi
summary: They are handsome guys who are cool but a little hard to approach. However, they...are all clumsy!!! Because they are clumsy, they're relatable. Because they are clumsy, they're adorable. You'll surely come to love them too! A slice of life comedy about guys who stay cool despite being clumsy!

name: Do It Yourself!
summary: Do It Yourself!! follows high school girls working on DIY projects, as they struggle, fail, yet don't give up and see the projects through to their end. The story depicts the lives of those girls as they take the first step toward the future.

name: Ark Peace
summary: As a doctor, Zhang Du Hang is far from impressed with Lu Yang as he finds her to be overly rational and calm. Lu Yang actually shares a similar contempt for his methods which she finds to be from the wild. They are both transferred to the same department leaving them no choice but to cooperate with each other in the face of urgent situations like a merchant ship in distress, transnational disaster relief, a virus epidemic and anti-terrorism efforts. Their story is an ode to the contemporary Chinese navy.

name: Bocchi the Rock!
summary: Hitori Gotou is a high school girl who's starting to learn to play the guitar because she dreams of being in a band, but she's so shy that she hasn't made a single friend. However, her dream might come true after she meets Nijika Ijichi, a girl who plays drums and is looking for a new guitarist for her band.

name: 28 Days Haunted
summary: Three teams each spend 28 days in some of America's most haunted locations for a paranormal experiment based on the theories of Ed and Lorraine Warren.

name: Waffles + Mochi's Restaurant
summary: Get bready for Waffles and Mochi to blast off on their tastiest adventure yet as they open their very own restaurant. As chefs, the two traveling taste-buddies serve up sweet, salty and spicy dishes inspired by the ingredients from their incr-edible explorations. The new season features familiar faces like Mrs. Obama and world-renowned chefs, home cooks, kids and celebrities from all over the globe who all share the same passion for food and fun!

name: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
summary: High drama on the high seas around Britain as multiple deep-sea fishing trips are filmed around the clock across one brutal week at sea. From the North Sea to the English Channel, all hunting the catch in 300,000 square miles of ocean.

name: Johnny vs Amber: The U.S. Trial
summary: The inside story of the trial that fascinated audiences across the globe. With intimate access to Depp's lawyers as well as legal experts close to the case, the series gives a forensic account of the legal battle from both sides.

name: The Challenge Workout
summary: Two-time champ Rachel Robinson and other competitors from The Challenge lead a series of total-body conditioning workouts.

name: A Cut Above
summary: A competition like no other, A Cut Above puts 12 of the best chainsaw carvers from across the world to the ultimate test of creativity, strength, and skills, as they turn ordinary logs into extraordinary works of art. Each episode, the carvers compete in weekly Quick and Master Carve challenges, while racing against the clock, in hopes of avoiding elimination. At the end of the grueling competition, the carver who out carves the rest, wins a cash prize and will be named "A Cut Above".

name: Liar
summary: Narita Misao is a rookie employee at a company. She doesn't like Ichikawa Kazuya, who works in the same department. He is brutally honest when he talks to other people. Nevertheless, an incident leads to Narita Misao developing feelings for him. Ichikawa Kazuya also beomes attracted to her. The couple soon enter into an intimate relationship, but Narita Misao learns afterwards that Ichikawa Kazuya is engaged to his girlfriend. Narita Misao is confused by the situation and wonders what he is thinking.

name: Aşk ve Umut
summary: Because of Gönül, Bülent and Feraye broke up, Bülent left home. Ege and Melis got married and moved in with Feraye, who was left alone. Zeynep buried her love in her heart and started a new life. The paths of Zeynep and Ege, who still love each other like crazy, separated due to Melis's pregnancy with Ege, will reunite with a painful loss. While all this is happening, Cihan, a young and strong man, enters Zeynep's life. Cihan is Seda's older brother. However, Cihan's powerful secret will not be able to stop his love. Although this secret brings Cihan and Ege face to face, the only thing the two men have in common is their love for Zeynep. Sıla was kidnapped by a fierce enemy of Kuzey. Kuzey has just realized his love for Sıla and searches for her everywhere. However, Cavidan, who is absolutely against Sıla and Kuzey coming together, will try to separate the two of them by using Alper. Cavidan's real plan is to marry Kuzey to his own daughter Bahar. Will Cavidan be able to achieve his goal?

name: Мартышкины
summary: Each family monkeys in its own way! Such different and such friendly Monkeys live in the center of a highly eco-friendly metropolis, surrounded by clever gadgets. Every day is a new adventure, in which there is a place for children's imagination and light hooliganism. Each new episode is one day of the life of big and small monkeys, something very monkey-like happens to them, but similar to human life.

name: 100 мест, где поесть
summary: Alexander Belkovich will go on a culinary tour around the country to draw up a gastronomic map of Russia.

name: Blumhouse's Compendium of Horror
summary: Blumhouse's Compendium of Horror revisits the shocks and scares from our favorite iconic cinematic horror moments from the 1930s until today featuring insights from some of the best and most influential filmmakers, producers, and actors working in the genre, as well as experts and historians. The series, narrated by Robert Englund, reflects how quintessential horror films have revealed and reflected the real-life scares of the world to the audience, uniting us with shared understanding, catharsis, and entertainment.

name: Tian Mei De Yao Hen
summary: An insufferably arrogant vampire prince falls in love with a lowly human commoner girl! In a forbidden game of cat and mouse, you cannot stop this blood-stained love. Gently taking a bite, you are my possession.

name: Sinú, río de pasiones
summary: The story of Felipe, a foreman on a farm, who falls in love with Lina. To overcome his economic limitations, Felipe accepts Marcos's proposal, which implies getting away from everything and assuming a new identity.

name: Черная богиня
summary: In a small southern Russian city, scorched by the hot sun and washed by the gentle sea, a beautiful woman lives carelessly, who does not even suspect how fragile her little world is. Overnight, she loses everything: her beloved husband, well-being and peace. Everyday life filled with quiet happiness is replaced by terrible shocks. But in the whirlpool of events, she does not bend, does not lose her humanity, but on the contrary, hitherto unknown forces are revealed in her, allowing her to regain herself and love...

name: Yavuz Sultan Selim
summary: The new Turkish series will tell about one of the most cruel and unprincipled rulers of the Ottoman Empire. For him, there were no rules and traditions, he acted as he saw fit. In order to achieve his goal and become a sultan, he killed both his father and his brothers. Among the people, Sultan Selim was nicknamed Yavuz the Terrible.

name: Monster High
summary: The all-new series follows the teenage children of famous monsters including Clawdeen Wolf, Draculaura, Frankie Stein, and Deuce Gorgon as they discover who they are, embrace their differences, and learn to be fierce and fearless at the one place they all belong: Monster High.

previousepisode.name: One Were to Rule Them All

name: Bros in Control
summary: The ultimate head-to-head contest, where best mates Adam Beales and Joe Tasker battle to be the best in the funniest, gungiest, and grossest games, created and controlled by Adam's little bro, Callum.

name: El Repatriado
summary: Leonel Reina is a young Latino boxer with dreams of becoming a champion. But Leonel's dreams are derailed when he's deported to Mexico and discovers that he was never naturalized as an American citizen. In a country where he doesn't speak the language, Leonel unexpectedly finds himself reconnecting with his roots and making new friends who set out to help him find his way back home.

name: Fresh Cuts
summary: Military, medicine, fashion - celebrate more stories by Black filmmakers. Fresh Cuts is a series of untold stories from new directors for Black History Month.

name: Wear the Rose: An England Rugby Dream
summary: Documentary following the England women's rugby team as they prepare for the Rugby World Cup in New Zealand, a tournament for which they are favourites.

name: Extreme E Highlights
summary: A chance to catch up with the latest action from the action-packed electric racing series, featuring an all-star field of drivers.

name: The Grand Fishing Adventure
summary: Can they reel in a catch? Join Ali and Bobby on their fishing adventures.

name: Прошлому меня не сломить
summary: Nina fails to keep her marriage, so the heroine and her teenage son moved to the regional center, where she gets a good job and a faithful friend. The woman will go through a lot of difficulties, face the ghosts of the past and meet true love.

name: Run for the Money
summary: Run for the Money is a reality competition show where celebrity participants can win a cash prize based on the time you spend running away from hunters. If you can escape to the end, you will win a large sum of money... Do you choose to turn yourself in? Or will you keep running to the end for money and for pride?

name: King the Land
summary: Set in the backdrop of a hotelier's dream, the VVIP business lounge 'King the Land', it depicts the story of a man who cannot withstand a fake smile and a woman who always has to smile brightly.

name: Super League Wrap-Up
summary: Adam Hills presents a behind-the-scenes look at the showpiece match.

name: Renovation Nation
summary: More renovators from all over the UK tackle crumbling period properties.

name: Jon Richardson: Take My Mother-in-Law
summary: The comedian sets about finding his mother-in-law Gill somewhere to retire to - and quickly - before she moves in with him.

name: The Antiques Yard
summary: Antiques and reclamation yard-owner Daniel Dawson-Gordon and his team as reclaim, restore and repair items - bringing the unloved back to life and selling them to new homes.

name: Hotel Cocaine
summary: Hotel Cocaine is set in the 1970s and early ‘80s Miami drug trade. It follows Cuban exile and CIA operative Roman Compte, who runs The Mutiny Hotel.

name: The Lincoln Project
summary: The Lincoln Project follows a veteran group of former GOP operatives and strategists known publicly as the Lincoln Project, the fastest-growing super PAC in America, as they take on the task of "saving democracy" and defeating their own party's sitting president.

name: Фантастика
summary: 12 participants are hiding behind the images of unusual creatures. Six of them are established stars, and six more are rising stars. "Fantastic" is an innovative show that works with real-time motion capture and calculation technologies. Digital shells created by designers and programmers, and real artists animating them, are an amazing attraction from the future and at the same time the process of birth of new heroes of the music scene.

name: Золотая теща
summary: Sergei Ivanovich lives in a civil marriage with the beautiful Svetlana. Her mother comes to her from the Ural hinterland. Antonina Petrovna travels to the capital to finally arrange her daughter's personal life. She is not at all satisfied with the fact that Sergey and Svetlana live without signing. With the arrival of dear mother, life ceases to seem ordinary and insipid. The mother-in-law is trying to transfer all her village habits to metropolitan life ...

name: Влюбись, если сможешь
summary: 11 participants are looking for their love in a villa in Cape Town. In addition to love, young people can break another solid jackpot — a big cash prize that is at stake.

name: Fixer Upper: The Castle
summary: Chip and Joanna take on their biggest fixer yet: the famous castle in Waco, Texas. As they breathe new life into the historic landmark, they must also tackle its challenging infrastructure while preserving its original beauty.

name: Gyeongseong Creature
summary: Gyeongseong, 1945. In Seoul's grim era under colonial rule, an entrepreneur and a sleuth fight for survival and face a monster born out of human greed.

name: Ninja Express
summary: Imagine a delivery service that delivers anything, anywhere and anytime. Now imagine it being run by three little Ninjas with incredible powers!

name: Confined Stories
summary: Series of five self-closing shorts of between 15 and 20 minutes shot by five prestigious directors (Fernando Colomo, Álvaro Fernández Armero, Miguel Bardem, David Marqués and with the directorial debut in audiovisual fiction by Juan Diego Botto) during confinement and without leaving home.

name: I Love You, You Hate Me
summary: I Love You, You Hate Me is a limited doc series chronicling the rise and fall of Barney the Dinosaur's furious backlash - and what it says about the human need to hate. From Barney-bashing to frat parties to homicidal video games, something in American society broke into a million pieces, and it's never been put together again... or is this just who we were all along?

name: The Hair Tales
summary: In The Hair Tales narrators and real-life friends Tracee Ellis Ross and Michaela angela Davis, lead the audience through a revelatory journey of connecting the personal tales of phenomenal Black women to broader societal and historic themes. The stories shared in the series offer an honest and layered look into the complex culture of Black hair and ultimately Black women's identity, creativity, and contributions to society – all delivered with a rare mix of intelligence, humor, style, joy, and justice.

name: Mujer de Madera
summary: Marissa is a sweet, caring woman who loses her father in a wild forest fire, then becomes the owner of her father's ranch, "Las Cúspides". She is deeply in love with Cesar, but their wedding is interrupted by a woman who claims to be pregnant by him. Marissa turns from her joyful, kind self into an embittered woman--a hardened "Wooden Woman."

name: Nevinné lži
summary: Everyone has their different personal reasons for not telling the truth. And yet we always understand them, comprehend them and believe them. That's us. But what if even such a small, intimate and seemingly innocent lie swell into unexpected dimensions and seize the opportunity to turn a life completely upside down?

name: Anna et Arnaud
summary: Following a serious trauma, Arnaud gradually loses his bearings and ends up in the street. His mother Anna, a talented seamstress, tries the impossible to get her son out of the fog and bring him back to solid ground, far from drugs and the cold.

previousepisode.name: Former Death Row Inmate Satake Hirofumi: An Ordinary, Run-of-the-Mill Guy

name: Маска. Танцы
summary: This is the first Russian version of the successful The Masked Dancer format, a spin-off of the famous The Masked Singer. Fourteen star participants will perform in the new project, and five jury members will try to guess who is behind the mask using clues. Sergei Svetlakov, Yegor Druzhinin, Klava Koka, Timur Rodriguez and Maria Gorban will be at the same judging table.

name: C*A*U*G*H*T
summary: C*A*U*G*H*T follows four Australian soldiers sent on a secret mission to a war-torn country. Mistaken for Americans, they are captured by freedom fighters and produce a hostage video that goes viral. When the soldiers reach celebrity status, they realise that being caught might just be the best thing that could've happened to them.

name: Who's Talking to Chris Wallace?
summary: Chris Wallace explores his wide range of interests across the spectrum of news, sports, entertainment, art, and culture - having candid conversations with a rich variety of guests.

name: Pawn Stars Do America
summary: For the first time, the "Pawn Stars" are hitting the road to visit some of America's most exciting places in search of historical finds and impressive collectible objects in the new 8-part series Pawn Stars Do America. Each two-hour episode follows Rick Harrison, Corey Harrison and Austin "Chumlee" Russell as they step out of the World Famous Gold & Silver Pawn Shop in Las Vegas to connect with fans in eight different cities and acquire some of the most remarkable items imaginable.

name: Britain's Greatest Ships
summary: Engineer Rob Bell returns with more investigations into British ships that changed the world.

previousepisode.name: The HMS Endeavour: Britain's Greatest Ships

name: A Shoulder to Cry On
summary:
At school, Lee Da Yeol spends most of his time living as an outsider. Not popular by any stretch of the imagination, Dae Yeol's only real joy comes from his time spent with the archery club. A talented archer whose skills have earned him a scholarship to the school, Dae Yeol doesn't mind being an outsider, so long as he's free to pursue his greatest passion. But an ill-timed run-in with a devilishly handsome classmate lands him in trouble and places his precious scholarship in jeopardy.

One of the school's most popular students, Jo Tae Hyun has always enjoyed a level of freedom that very few high school students have ever attained. Able to get away with practically anything, the entire school has no problem believing his side of the story when he's caught fooling around in the nurse's office with another student and Da Yeol. Claiming Da Yeol was trying to make out with him, Tae Hyun thoughtlessly puts the archer's scholarship at risk. Desperate to correct the misunderstanding, Da Yeol does everything he can to try to quell the rumors but no matter how hard he tries, it's just not enough.

Completely unremorseful about what he's done, Tae Hyun seems to take a wicked sort of delight in doing everything he can to make Da Yeol's life miserable; his favorite method being to follow Da Yeol everywhere. Unable to shake Tae Hyun, Da Yeol spends his days loathing his shadow but the more time he spends with him, the more conflicted his feelings become; leaving him to wonder, where exactly does the line between hate and love end?

name: Miskina, la pauvre
summary: Chronicling the misadventures of Fara, a 30 year old woman, with no flat, no job, and no boyfriend, who faces family pressure to finally grow up.

name: The Expanse: One Ship
summary: An anthology of short webisodes of The Expanse, all relating to the Doctrine of One Ship - that there is only one ship, and it has countless parts as a single body has countless cells.

name: Human Playground
summary: Narrated by Idris Elba, this docuseries explores the origins and evolution of play across the globe, from age-old rituals to billion-dollar businesses.

name: Secret Societies: In the Shadows
summary: Secret rituals. Blood oaths. Dark ceremonies. Fraternal orders. Around the world, and throughout history, secret societies have bubbled under the surface. In crypts and clubhouses, under lock and key, in the darkest corners of the internet, they assemble for mysterious purposes. Do they pull the levers of power or set out to destroy the ones in charge? What dark mysteries lurk behind closed doors; the sacred or the profane?

previousepisode.name: The Hermetic order of the Golden Dawn

name: Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty
summary: When the dark evil immortal descends from the heaven, and the mysterious underground ghost palace was revealed, a strange herb named the Black Tea suddenly took Chang'an City by storm. However, no one knows whether it is a healthy medicine or one that could harm people. Cases of missing brides in Chang'an City began occurring one after another, which seems to be inextricably linked to the black tea... Ling Feng, general of the Jin Wu guards was tasked to investigate these cases. On his journey, he meets his strongest opponent in Su Wu Ming, the disciple of Di Ren Jie. The two of them work together to solve these mysterious cases.

name: Mr. Bad
summary: A reversal on the typical love story follows a young woman named Nan Xing who loves to write. While making a wish, she accidentally summons the villain from her own book! When Xiao Wu Di, the clever, cunning and narcissistic "big villain" from the book, first came to this world, he resorted to threats and blackmail to live next door to Nan Xing. It marks the start of a life of endless mischief and fighting between two neighbours.

name: Viola come il mare
summary: Viola Vitale, a gorgeous and magnetic woman who has always worked in the field of fashion journalism, moves from Paris to Palermo, armed only with optimism and trust, in search of the father she has never known.

name: A Jeremy Vine Debate Special
summary: Jeremy Vine hosts live debates for Channel 5.

previousepisode.name: Live: Britain on Strike - The Debate

name: Neviditelní
summary: A businessman discovers he has a hidden gene that enables him to breathe water, threatening the existence of the secret Aquarian race, in this charming, comedic fantasy from the Czech Republic.

name: The Submarine Killer: Confessions of a Murderer
summary: Peter Madsen was convicted of murdering journalist Kim Wall on board his private submarine, but he has never confessed to the crime. During more than twenty hours of telephone interviews, Madsen talks about details that have never been made public before.

name: The TikTok Man: Catching a Predator
summary: For more than a decade, a predator in Denmark has used social media as his hunting ground, leading to over 400 reports of online sexual harassment, violence and rape. Victims share their stories as one mother works to build what could be a landmark case.

name: One Cup of Tea
summary: One Cup of Tea is Hulu's official Ramy Aftershow that offers an insightful look into the new season. It is hosted by Ramy Youssef, Hiam Abbass and Laith Nakli. Each episode features special guests to help unpack the topics and themes of the groundbreaking Hulu Original series.

previousepisode.name: Are we in control of our lives?

name: Tagarin
summary:
Tagārin is a short-form spin-off series from the 2013 Galileo drama (Season 2), consisting of 11 episodes, each around 7 minutes long. It aired on Fuji TV in a late-night time slot.

The show follows Detective Minoru Ōtagawa, a supporting character from Galileo Season 2. He teams up with Chihiro Ejima, a female traffic officer, to investigate off-the-record or covert cases that aren't part of official police reports.

Unlike the main Galileo series, which centers on physicist Yukawa solving strange scientific phenomena, Tagārin focuses on minor side cases, interpersonal banter, and has a more comedic, lighthearted tone. Yukawa himself does not appear in this spin-off.

While not essential to the main plot of Galileo, Tagārin expands the universe by showcasing what happens behind the scenes with side characters. It gives fans a broader perspective of the Galileo world and adds charm to the supporting cast.

name: Sabriya
summary: 16-year-old girl named Sabriya is blamed for the relationship she has with the guy she loves. Her father has no other choice than giving her as a second wife to 60-year-old man after a shameful action of Sabriya and her loved one. The drama tries to show some problems of community through the destiny of Sabriya and her family.

name: Eränkävijät
summary: Eränkävijät is a TV series about hunting and fishing in modern Finland. The series follows the stories of the main characters in the hunting and fishing community. They are united by their love for Finnish nature, even though their backgrounds and stories are different and they come from different parts of Finland. While in the north the fells are covered in snow and the lakes are frozen, in the south people still walk on the melting ground and fish in the flowing waters. And while big game is hunted on the eastern frontier, in the north the traditional methods are used to catch chickens. The conservation of game and fish stocks is still a hobby and a way of life for the wildlife enthusiast.

name: Direktøren
summary: It is the summer of 2014, and an American couple will end their European holiday with a few days in Oslo. The year before, they met the businessman Øystein, who now opens the doors for the couple. The atmosphere is good, but then everything goes wrong.

name: Petter og overleverne
summary: Petter møter personer som er utsatt for traumatiske hendelser. Hvordan klarer de å ta tilbake hverdagen etter at noen stjal den fra dem?

name: David Bull
summary: David Bull brings you the biggest stories of the day that matter to you.

name: Claudia Liza
summary: Start your weekend off in the very best way with Claudia Liza bringing you the biggest stories of the day that matter to you.

name: Russell Quirk
summary: Start your weekend off in the very best way with Russell Quirk bringing you the biggest stories of the day that matter to you.

name: André Walker
summary: Today's top stories.

name: The Sunday Night Club with Jonny Gould
summary: Jonny Gould reflects on the sporting weekend and more.

name: Help! My Kid is a Gamer!
summary: Host Nich Richardson speaks to the experts on a variety of topics around how children can lead a healthy gaming life: from online safety and etiquette, to the realities of a career in Esports, becoming a YouTuber, and more.

name: Детективный синдром
summary: Pavel is an ordinary young man whose father once left the family without explanation. But, instead of being angry with the parent, Pasha does not believe that dad could have done a bad deed on purpose and decides to investigate his disappearance, coming up with all sorts of theories, and checking their truth in the course of events. Life without a father turns out to be difficult - the boy is pressed by financial need, and he entangles with the crime boss Herman, who gives his ward small assignments for a good fee. One day, a bandit instructs Pasha to carry a bag of money, but during the trip, he loses it. Realizing that things are bad, the guy decides to try to find the bag on his own. The search leads him to a lunatic asylum.

name: Eternal Boys
summary: The story follows six middle-aged men who have experienced success and failures in their lives. One day, they decide to become an idol group and overcome such barriers as their age and their physical condition.

name: Royals: Keeping the Crown
summary: Nothing quite captures the world's attention like the rise, the fall, and the rebranding of royalty. From Queen Victoria's attempts to unite Europe, to the end of Russia's Romanovs, right up to Princes William and Harry, this series explores the survival strategies of royals through the ages.

name: Ran
summary: Five men who grew up together plan an enormous robbery.

name: Tilbake til 90 tallet
summary: From NRK's archive, we get a half-hour look back at each of the years from 1990 to 1999, and meet people who left their mark on the decade in various ways.

name: Tilbake til 2000-tallet
summary: Three actors take a look back at a decade of terror, smartphones, Facebook, the crown prince's wedding, Olympic gold and the financial crisis.

name: Emilie Meng - en efterforskning går galt
summary: Three years after Emilie Meng disappeared, the police have still not found Emilie's killer. Is this an extremely cunning perpetrator, or have the police overlooked a number of obvious clues.

name: Skårungen
summary: 12 participants fight to become Norway's best skår cub.

name: Tilbake til 70 tallet
summary: Join us back to the most important events of the 70s, and meet people who in various ways left their mark on this particular decade.

name: Truls - Oppdrag Norge
summary: Truls Svendsen is going on new adventures in the sequel to "Truls – Oppdrag Hurtigruten", and it is his comrades who decide where and what he is going to. This time, Cecilie Skog is also involved in deciding which assignments he must carry out on the trip.

name: Tilbake til 60 tallet
summary: Join us back to the most important events of the 60s, and meet people who in various ways left their mark on this particular decade.

name: Nordmennenes Egen Historie
summary: The Norwegians' own history is based exclusively on documentary footage found in national and local historical archives, the basements of businesses and associations and, not least, the Norwegians' own drawers and cupboards. All spiced up with stories and quotes from first-hand sources and eyewitnesses.

name: Torsdagsfilmen
summary: Comedy drama with five independent films. Erik Solbakken and Morten Ramm interpret the major film genres and give them their own humorous twist. The Thursday film gives you Nordic noir, war drama, romantic action comedy, psychological thriller and family drama.

previousepisode.name: Arne og Amadeus: Brødre for alltid

name: Falling Into You
summary:
Duan Yu Cheng, an energetic young man who grew up in a fishing village on a small island in Fujian Province, dreams of becoming a high jumper. Luo Na is a talent hunter, an experienced assistant coach of the South Lake University athletics team.
In order to get more professional guidance and help, Duan Yu Cheng made every effort to enter the university where he trains Luo Na, and, becoming a member of Luo Na's team, began to realize his dream of high jumping. To realize a dream can be very tough-you can experience injuries, failures and loneliness that no one can understand, but it is also very sweet, because every grain of joy from improving the result can surpass the pain of the body and the doubts of others.
Under Luo's step-by-step guidance, Duan Yu Cheng's result improves, but the two also fall in love with each other.
Based on the novel of the same name Twentine.

name: My Deepest Dream
summary:
Wu Yu studies mathematics, and Tan Jiao makes a living writing detective novels. Wu Yu and Tan Jiao were engulfed in a whirlwind romance after meeting each other on a cruise ship. The two fall in love with each other, but end their journey with varying degrees of memory loss. Wu Yu does not remember a few days after his trip, while Tan Jiao has lost almost a year and a half of memories.
Wu Yu is a gifted mathematician and an excellent student with a bright future. His life changes dramatically when his mother and younger sister, who are his only relatives, suddenly die. To find the real killer, he works as an auto mechanic and crosses paths with Tan Jiao again.
Based on the novel of the same name by Ding Mo.

name: Smile to Life
summary:
Xu Duo Cheng is a young girl full of joy and life. No one knows that there is a shadow behind her smile: she actually suffers from ALS (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, ALS), which means that she does not have long to live and in the end she will be slowly but surely paralyzed. Because of this, Duo Cheng is doing his best to fully enjoy the rest of his days. But things get more complicated when she meets a handsome young musician, Jiang Nan, who falls in love with her. Will she surrender to her heart or leave it to protect it from pain?
Adapted from the novel of the same name by Jiu Sui He.

name: Lip Sync Battle
summary: Meet Norwegian celebrities in a completely unfamiliar situation. On stage wearing full costume with dancers, two high-profile people will fight in a duel where it is necessary to deliver the most impressive musical mime performance as well as the most entertaining stage show.

name: Julefergå
summary: Julefergå takes you on board the ferry "MF Svelå" Here you meet the kiosk lady Wenke, the ticket takers Trond and Roger, the skipper, the engineer and the ferry goat Einar - in addition to the musical crew of one ship that went down a long time ago....

name: Class
summary: Three students from a poor neighborhood join an exclusive high school for Delhi elite where dark secrets and rumors ultimately lead to murder.

name: Li Ba Shanhe Xi Zi Tang
Mare fuori
summary: The Institute of Juvenile Penalty of Naples is overlooking the sea and hosts seventy inmates: 50 males and 20 females. When they come in, the kids are always under 18 and they do it because they "made a mistake". This series tells their stories.

name: We Bought a Funeral Home
summary: From bats to a slew of haunting surprises, the Blumberg family transforms an eerie 1800s Victorian funeral parlor into a weird and wonderful dream home, and it has them wondering if they're alone on this renovation adventure.

name: Rampvlucht
summary: When on October 4, 1992, a Boeing 747 of the Israeli airline company El Al crashes into an apartment building in Amsterdam's Bijlmermeer, the Netherlands is suddenly world news. The investigation into the cause shows that a safety pin has come loose from one of the engines. Just very unlucky. Fortunately, it was a freight plane with only perfume, flowers and computer parts on board, says The Hague. The black box cannot be found. After a period of national mourning, the Netherlands is returning to business as usual.

name: Chef Swap at the Beach
summary: Host Amanda Frietag heads to the beach to challenge two local chefs to trade restaurants and cook a meal in each other's kitchen.

name: That's My DJ
summary: From heartbeat to heartbreak, chasing dreams & chasing highs, That's My DJ is an unapologetic look inside the new order of rave.

name: Content Cop
summary: In an effort to bring justice to the YouTube community, former police officer Ian Carter takes on the title of "Content Cop". Using his old police uniform and raw wit, Ian sets out to stop the creators that bring nothing but discord to his online city.

name: Tama and Friends
summary: The daily life of a small cat named Tama and his cat and dog friends. As their curiosity is aroused, they learn the values of friendship and teamwork.

name: Vanessa Feltz
summary: Vanessa guides you through the big stories of the day from the world of politics, current affairs and showbiz; big names, exclusive interviews, and your thoughts on what's got the nation talking.

name: Plank of the Week
summary: Nobody is safe as Mike Graham presents the ultimate panel show where the guests get to nominate their Plank of the Week.

name: Jeremy Kyle Live
summary: The show which packs a punch with fiery political panel debates, all the latest from Parliament, and exclusive interviews with big-name celebrities.

name: 2DEZIT
summary: College life tests the relationship of two high school sweethearts. They are soon sucked into a world full of sex, drink and drugs, but also deep conversations, experiments and (emotional) hangovers by their four roommates.

name: Tilbake til 80-tallet
summary: Join us back to the shoulder pads, the support concerts and the Japs' decade and meet people who in various ways left their mark on this time.

name: Roggin's Heroes
summary: A weekly comedy show featuring Los Angeles sports reporter Fred Roggin who shares humorous clips of everyday life and sports bloopers from around the world.

name: Jack Osbourne's Haunted Homecoming
summary: The world-famous ghost hunter returns to his childhood home in the notorious paranormal hot spot of Buckinghamshire, UK, seeking the dark truth behind the mysteries from his past.

name: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc - Memorial Edition
summary: The lone mercenary Guts travels a land where a century-old war is raging. His ferocity and skill in battle attract the attention of Griffith, the leader of a group of mercenaries called the Band of the Hawk. Guts becomes Griffith's closest ally and confidant, but despite all their victories, Guts begins to question why he fights for another man's dream of ruling his own kingdom. Unknown to Guts, Griffith's unyielding ambition is about to bestow a horrible fate on them both.

name: Urusei Yatsura
summary:
Tokyo. Tomobiki Town.

Lum, the gorgeous daughter of an invading race of Oni Aliens is smitten with High School student Ataru Moroboshi.

A dedicated womanizer, Ataru is unfazed by Lum's fierce electric shock attacks and continues his daily hunt for pretty girls.

With a host of other unique characters, including classmate Shinobu, elegant shrine maiden Sakura, Lum's best friend's Oyuki, Benten and Ran, Buddhist Monk Cherry, Ten, the little brat, heir to a wealthy family Shutaro Mendo and the secretly female beauty Ryunosuke…

A classic slapstick love comedy where anything goes!

previousepisode.name: Boy Meets Girl: I Want You When I Can't Have You

name: Le dernier soir
summary: Journalist Monic Néron begins to shed new light on one of Quebec's rare double murders of unsolved teenagers; that of 13-year-old Diane Déry and Mario Corbeil, 15.

name: Chicken Nugget
summary: A woman steps into an odd machine and becomes... a chicken nugget?! Now, it's up to her father and admirer to embark on a zany quest to bring her back.

name: Pikmin
summary: Watch the colorful antics of Pikmin as they jump into three short movies, the first movies ever directed by Shigeru Miyamoto. The three shorts, titled The Night Juicer, Treasure in a Bottle and Occupational Hazards find Pikmin in unusual, funny, and even dangerous situations. NOTE: No real Pikmin were harmed during the filming of these movies.

name: Power Trip: Those Who Seek Power and Those Who Chase Them
summary: A groundbreaking political series, hosted by George Stephanopoulos, bringing viewers inside the top stories of the election campaign each week from an unparalleled, ground-level perspective.

name: Встречная полоса
summary: A car accident turns the life of the Krapivins forever. Igor ends up in the hospital with a severe head injury, and his wife, Lyuba, discovers the shocking truth. It turns out that her beloved husband is cheating on her. Lyuba learns about this from the messages that come to Igor's phone from his young mistress Nika. Lyuba is faced with a serious choice - whether to reveal the truth about her husband's betrayal of the family? Do I need to confess to my husband's mistress that Lyuba is aware of their relationship? And, finally, what should I do - fight for Igor's life or leave him?

name: Trial of the Century
summary: A fictional courtroom drama which shows how the trial of Pádraig Pearse, one of the leaders of the 1916 Easter Rising, might have gone.

name: Carmen Curlers
summary: Dansk dramaserie inspireret af virkelige hændelser. Året er 1963 i en lille dansk provinsby. Den lokale tv-forretningsejer Axel får chancen for at investere i en elektrisk curler og ser en mulighed for at revolutionere skønhedsindustrien og opnå den store succes, han altid har drømt om. Bondekonen Birthes søn skal konfirmeres, og hun planlægger den store dag. Økonomien er dog stram, og Birthe og hendes mand, Jørgen, er bestemt ikke enige om, hvordan de få penge skal forvaltes.

name: The Ice Cream Wars
summary: In 1984 six Glasgow family members died in an arson attack. Their murders were followed by one of Scotland's longest trials and a 20-year fight for justice that gripped the nation.

name: A House of Blocks
summary: Half-sisters Kaiqi and Yijuan depended on each other after their parents died in a car accident. The two went on different paths in character and life.

name: Roommates of Poongduck 304
summary:
As a third-generation chaebol and undoubted future heir to the Guemman Group, Ji Ho Joon was raised with the world at his feet. Now a happy-go-lucky twenty-something, Ho Joon doesn't have a care in the world. Certain he's destined to live the privileged life forever, Ho Joon is shocked when his father presents him with an unexpected and rather unpleasant ultimatum.

Kicked out of the house by his well-meaning father, without a penny to his name, Ho Joon must now find a way to survive on his own for the next two years. As if floundering for survival wasn't bad enough, Ho Joon must take a position as the team leader of the Guemman Group's newest business team and deliver some impressive results. With no idea where to go or how to begin this impossible quest, Ho Joon soon finds himself the resident of Poongduck Villa and at the mercy of the villa's owner, Seo Jae Yoon.

As difficult as life might presently seem for Ho Joon, it gets even more complicated when he realizes that Jae Yoon works at his family's company and has recently been assigned to his newfound team. Could this seemingly cruel twist of fate be exactly what both Ho Joon and Jae Yoon need?

name: Andropoz
summary: Amid the onset of andropause, a 50-something family man becomes obsessed with change and decides to pursue happiness. Then he bungles it up completely.

name: Abu & Mayoos Norge
summary: Abu and Mayoo were born and raised in Norway, but have never skied, hiked in the mountains or fished. Now they go around the country to try typically Norwegian activities.

name: Contigo Capitán
summary: Peruvian soccer star Paolo Guerrero wages a difficult legal battle after testing positive for cocaine months before the World Cup. Based on a true story.

name: Another Monday
summary: Imagine you have just one day left to live -- but that day repeats forever. Three people discover that they are caught in a time-loop. Soon the whole world is divided into two groups.

name: The War of Beauties
summary: Chung Ka-po, Lam Siu-mei and Lee Ching-yee are sisterly buddies. Due to different reasons after graduation, the trio gradually go their separate ways. Ka-po is arbitrarily nominated by Siu-mei to participate in a school beauty contest organized by some magazine. Ka-po is eventually the unchallenged winner, and the Golden Agent Wing Yat-yin then convinces her to join his agency. Yat-yin encourages Ka-po to sign up for the Miss Hong Kong Pageant. However, Chung Ka-kei, who is Ka-po's fellow contestant and also younger stepsister, frames her. And then Ka-po manages to enter showbiz, which is more like a "battlefield". She also befriends Pong Chun-yu, who is the son of some tycoon. After the couple get married, Ka-po finds herself in another "battlefield" that is the domain of some distinguished family. Moreover, Ka-po is drifting away from her two bosom girlfriends. Is it actually jealousy, dignity, wealth or something else that causes the friends to go cold on each other?

name: Five: Thirty
summary: Getting married to the powerful political leader Ghimar el-Ghanem should have been every girl's dream, but Bayan's dream soon becomes a nightmare when he turns her life into a living hell. Her only way out of her will be to throw herself in the arms of her handsome bodyguard who won't resist her temptation.

name: Соболев_тут
summary: An entertaining travel show in which comedian Ilya Sobolev travels around the cities of Russia and, together with local residents, explores unusual places. To release a wounded burial ground, to receive magical protection from a hermit monk, to catch a huge catfish on foam plastic - exciting adventures have been prepared for Sobolev in every city. At the end of each issue, Ilya will perform with a stand-up concert and improvisation with the audience.

name: Udaariyaan
summary: Hailing from a small village in Punjab, the Sandhu family is driven by one obsession: migrate to Canada. A cruel twist of fate, however, has different plans for the two sisters Tejo and Jasmine when the dashing Fateh comes to their lives.

name: I AM A STALKER
summary: Convicted stalkers and survivors share harrowing accounts of harassment, abuse and other crimes in this documentary series.

name: Інструкція.ЮА
summary:
Instruction.UA is a YouTube show about what Ukrainians are made of

Ukrainians still do not have a tablet in which they can find answers to basic and at the same time fundamental questions about themselves. Who are we? What do we want? What is the meaning of our existence? How are we arranged? What does and doesn't a Ukrainian do? What is the mission of Ukrainians in this world?

Instruction.UA is an online tablet on the new worldview YouTube channel "Anthropology" from Suspilne Media. A show with Ivan Semesiuk, where he and his guests seek answers to these questions.

The guests of the show are experts from various spheres of Ukrainian life: from culture to business, from humour to war, and from history to politics. The show's goal is to capture Ukrainians in space and time, understand them as best as possible, and ultimately agree among themselves on what to do with all this.

name: Мен не ме мислете
summary: Мен не ме мислете  is the story of a young unusual divorced mother, who always searches for justice and manages to always have her head up, despite her problems.

name: Elgorado
summary: An encounter with the forest's most majestic animal can be fun, exciting or life-threatening. And more and more people film their moose experiences. In the Nordic region, the elk is doing well, it is an Elgorado.

name: The Elon Musk Show
summary: Uncovering the story of how Elon Musk became the richest man who has ever lived.

name: The Trials That Shocked Scotland
summary: From the longest criminal trial in UK history, to headline-hitting murder prosecutions, this series revisits 12 high-profile and memorable court cases which shocked Scotland.

name: 10 Things You Don't Know
summary: Each comedic half-hour self-contained episode will highlight a celebrity and countdown the 10 most unique and surprising facts you don't know about them. From Brad Pitt and Jennifer Lopez to Keanu Reeves, Tiffany Haddish, Lady Gaga and more, the series will uncover all the hysterical, outrageous, only-in-Hollywood scoop that prove stars really are just like us. These facts will get crazier and more unbelievable, ending with the most mind-blowing revelation that will leave even the most hardcore fans saying "WTF!".

name: Thong EK: The Herbal Master
summary: A romantic comedy set during the reign of Rama 5 (Chulalongkorn). Thong In is an experienced doctor who has treated many people. He has a grandson named Thong Ake who wants to become a traditional doctor. He also studies ancient Thai medicine. One day, Thong In isolates himself after one of his patients dies and he's blamed for his death. He doesn't want Thong Ake to become a doctor and go through the same. Still, Thong Ake is determined to prove himself to his grandfather. Chaba is a tough and fearless girl. She prefers to fight with swords than do household chores. After meeting Thong Ake's grandfather, she becomes interested in traditional medicine and wants to become a doctor as well. Thong Ake starts teaching her and although they don't get along at first, they eventually fall in love.

name: Avant le crash
summary: Marc-André is a marginal out of the system and in voluntary simplicity mode. He claims it's by choice. His friends François, Evelyne and Patrick all have meteoric careers in finance at Olstrom, except Vincent who took refuge in a civil service job after a burnout. François offers Marc-André an opportunity to return to the world of investment banking… but at the bottom of the ladder, it's a question of getting back on track. Will Marc-André accept the offer? Will he return to an environment he left four years ago, promising himself never to return to, this environment where he was successful but who got the better of him?

name: Suptar 2550
summary: Leading man Ryu was at the height of his fame in 2007. Since then, his star has been in decline. Now, he wants to return to work and get his reputation back.

name: Riches
summary: Riches follows the exploits of the stylish, privileged, super-successful Richards family. When Stephen Richards passes suddenly, the family's world comes crashing down. As his business hangs in the balance, his different sets of children are about to collide as they vie for control.

name: Play-Doh Squished
summary: Play-Doh Squished is the ultimate Play-Doh competition. Three teams of adults and kids go toe-to-toe in exciting challenges - all designed to test their artistry, speed, and skill. First, they'll face a wild "mini-challenge," followed by a race through the colorful arena, all leading to the final test of their imaginations - creating an epic Play-Doh world. One team will become our Play-Doh champs, and the others will get squished!

name: The Williams Family Cabin
summary: First-time renovators learn that renovation is full of surprises as they transform a cabin just outside of Nashville into a creative retreat while balancing their full-time jobs and four kids.

name: Creating the World of Harry Potter
summary: Explore the World of Harry Potter through the behind the scenes creation of the films.

name: Hitler: Germany's Fatal Attraction
summary: As April 2015 marked the 70th anniversary of the death of Adolf Hitler, this documentary investigates the before, during and final days of the most terrifying dictator of the western world. The three-part series features rare archive footage and expert analysis from Sir Richard Evans, Regius Professor of History at the University of Cambridge; Martin Kemp, Emeritus Professor of the History of Art, Oxford University; and Nicolas O'Shaugnessy, Professor of Communication at Queen Mary, University of London

name: Взгляд
summary: Vzglyad is a popular Russian TV program, officially broadcast from 2 October 1987 to April 2001. It is one of the first programs that changed Russian notions on television. It is one of the main programs of the television company VID.

name: Bookie
summary: A veteran bookie struggles to survive the impending legalization of sports gambling, increasingly unstable clients, family, co-workers, and a lifestyle that bounces him around every corner of Los Angeles, high and low.

name: Hometown
summary: Journalists explore tragic events that have happened in their hometowns.

name: The Very Very Best of the 80s
summary: Kelly Osborne and a group of experts examine the best 80s movies, music and more!

name: Making Black America: Through the Grapevine
summary: A four-part series hosted by Henry Louis Gates, Jr., that chronicles the vast social networks and organizations created by and for Black people—beyond the reach of the "White gaze." Professor Gates sits with noted scholars, politicians, cultural leaders, and old friends to discuss this world behind the color line and what it looks like today.

name: Forty Millenniums of Cultivation
summary: "Even if this universe is truly nothing more than a brutal bloody shadowy forest, we Cultivators will burn all that we have just to give off a single weak flickering spark in the darkness! "No matter how weak each spark is, how short-lived, how small… As long as the sparks flow unabated, then one day one of those sparks will light some tinder, and that tinder shall light some fallen branches, and those branches shall set ablaze each and every last tree of the forest! "In the end, even the smallest sparks will eventually set the shadowy forest ablaze and illuminate the whole world!" (NovelUpdate) In a world teeming with cultivators, Li Yao, who makes his living collecting scrap metal, encounters the soul of a titan powerhouse from forty thousand years in the past.

name: Apagón
summary: The reaction of the State and prevention organizations, the lack of resources in health centers, the formation of street gangs and neighborhood ghettos, the isolation in rural areas... After the blackout, the world has completely changed and society treats to adapt to a new reality, facing the most basic needs, instincts and fears.
